channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Gold, silver prices fall on MCX ahead of US inflation data
item.description: Recent job market data has already added to such expectations, with the US unemployment rate rising to 4.6 per cent in November, the highest level seen since September 2021.

item.title: Delhi enforces ‘No PUC, No Fuel’ rule from today; bars BS-VI vehicles from outside
item.description: The national capital continues to gasp under severe pollution, prompting the Delhi government to announce an expansive set of emergency and long-term measures targeting vehicular emissions, dust, waste and traffic congestion.

item.title: Vijay to address rally in Tamil Nadu’s Erode today amid strict crowd control arrangements
item.description: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) leader Vijay will address a major campaign rally in Vijayamangalam in Tamil Nadu's Erode district, on Thursday, marking his first large public event in the state since the September 27 Karur tragedy.

item.title: Ola Electric shares slide 3 pc as Bhavish Aggarwal sells Rs 142 crore worth of stake
item.description: Shares of Ola Electric Mobility Limited slipped further on Thursday after founder and promoter Bhavish Aggarwal sold another chunk of his personal shareholding through open market transactions.

item.title: Pakistan’s ban fails: Dhurandhar turns into underground sensation
item.description: The ban on Dhurandhar by Pakistan and some Gulf nations has not affected its run at the box office. The movie is showing no signs of slowing down, but the ISI has a major problem back in Pakistan.

item.title: Suspected damage to aircraft tyre leads to diversion of the flight: Air India Express
item.description: A potential aviation incident was avoided on Thursday after an Air India Express flight from Jeddah to Kozhikode was diverted to Kochi due to suspected damage to the aircraft’s tyre.

item.title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan to reply on G Ram G Bill in LS today
item.description: Union Minister for Agriculture and Rural Development Shivraj Singh Chouhan is set to deliver the government's reply on the Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Bill, 2025 (VB-G RAM-G Bill) on Thursday.

item.title: NDA, Opposition lock horns over replacing MGNREGA with Viksit Bharat G RAM G Bill
item.description: The NDA on Thursday defended the introduction of the Viksit Bharat G RAM G Bill, saying it would benefit those seeking employment under the scheme, even as the Opposition remained unconvinced and strongly criticised the Centre for removing the name of Mahatma Gandhi from the legislation.

item.title: IndiGo restores 2,200 flights, focuses on rebuilding: CEO
item.description: IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers on Thursday said the airline has restored its operations to 2,200 flights a day and that the worst phase of the recent disruption is now behind the company.

item.title: Kerala High Court stays ED notice against CM Vijayan in KIIFB Masala Bonds case
item.description: The Kerala High Court on Thursday stayed the Enforcement Directorate’s (ED) notices issued in connection with funds raised through Masala Bonds by the Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB), granting interim relief to Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, former Finance Minister Thomas Isaac, KIIFB CEO K.M. Abraham and the KIIFB.
